maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The superior keypoints are positioned approximately 10-15mm dorsally from the secondary dense row, exhibiting a near-parallel horizontal distribution with a slight ventral-posterior tilt.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 88% melanin saturation; dark pixels dominate the rhinarium's lateral and ventral margins, while pink/pale depigmented pixels are concentrated in small, irregular clusters on the dorsal apex and along the philtrum boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A circular, erythematous lesion approximately 5-7mm in diameter with localized alopecia is present on the lower right maxillary region. Minor depigmented pitting and shallow abrasions are visible on the dorsal surface of the rhinarium.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric depigmentation pattern on the rhinarium apex consisting of a small cluster of pale pixels on the viewer's left-center.
